declarations.name: unspecialized
declarations.comment: Two minor wording issues in the single sentence. (1) "of the annotated method" is redundant — the annotation is by definition on the method being described, so the phrase adds no information. (2) "derived from the enclosing specialized type parameters" is an imprecise verb choice: specialized variants are generated or produced based on type-parameter specialization constraints, not derived from the parameters themselves. "generated from" or "based on" would be cleaner. Neither issue makes the sentence unreadable, but the combination leaves the sentence slightly wordy and mildly misleading.
